Note is a place to form ideas, experiment with sounds and find direction. Get your ideas out or play until inspiration hits using a selection of Ableton Live’s drum kits, synths and melodic instruments. Or create your own sound palette by recording the sounds around you into Note’s sampler instruments using your phone’s microphone. 

If you want to take your ideas further, use Ableton Cloud to send your projects to Live (version 11.2.5 or later) without leaving the app. Open your project from Live’s browser, then keep working – you can edit all your MIDI notes, and all your samples and sounds from Note are exactly the same.

The touch control system lets you lock in a scale so that you'll never play a wrong note, which makes it easy to play, even on your iPhone. It's polyphonic, which means you can use multiple fingers at once to play chords and harmonies. Plus, you can perform sweeping slides and expressive gestures that would be practically impossible on a regular keyboard.

While it's designed to be simple and fun, that doesn't mean it's only for beginners. Bebot has been used both on stage and in the studio by accomplished musicians and performers including Dream Theater, How To Destroy Angels and The Flaming Lips.

W-AIR MIDI is a midi enabled app which sends and receives MIDI messages and is designed to be a companion app for the BOSS Waza Air Headphones as well as midi capable foot pedals and controllers.  Via the use of midi messages, the app can select/retrieve presets, adjust and toggle effects, and adjust some of the effects settings.  The app provides a full touch interface as well as mapping of midi CC codes to most controls for midi controller or foot pedal use.

Specific features include:

- Preset selection which retrieves the preset and displays the preset's effects state and levels
- Gauges for Boost, Mod, Fx, Delay 1, Delay 2, Reverb, and Ambience with level change (slider under the gauge) or on/off toggle (tapping the gauge)
- Each effect displays the active effect colour and name, and tapping this will cycle through the three effects (green, red, yellow)
- The effect assignment to each colour block can be swapped from the list of effects via the swap icon to the left of the effect colour block
- Some effects settings are exposed and can be edited via the levels icon to the right of the effect colour block
- Tap tempo can be set with a slider or tap for both delay 1 and delay 2, showing both BPM and millisecond intervals.  The tap tempo also has a copy and half value copy feature between the two tap tempos
- Faders for Gain and Volume control
- Noise Gate setting
- Preset EQ, Bass, Mid, Treble, and Global EQ settings
- Selector switches for Amp Selector, Gyro Selector, Sound Selector, and Cabinet
- Battery level indicator
- Tuner
- Decoupling of Fx/Delay and Mod/Boost so that all effects can be used simultaneously
- Allows preset settings to be saved (including name updates) as well as exported and imported
- Assignable Midi CC codes for most controls via a Midi learn mode feature (when activated, the app listens for incoming CC code and shows that code in the learned code box, simply tap the gauge or slider you wish to assign that code to).
- Midi CC mapped controls can be used to select presets, toggle effects on/off, cycle through the effect block/colour, open effects settings, move faders (with an expression pedal or volume knob) and the same CC code can be assigned to more than one control when appropriate (i.e. one button to toggle the Fx and Boost at the same time)
- Assigned CC codes are preserved as user settings and recalled when restarting the app
- Supports landscape,  portrait, as well as split view
- The screen is zoomable with pinch gesture.  This is useful for Split View and resizing the Split View of this app to fit the screen
- A bluetooth device discovery page is available from within the app (to view/select the connection state of the headphones and any midi bluetooth pedals detected)

This app is not meant or intended to replace the official BOSS BTS app, it simply exposes some of the most common settings that would be adjusted while playing.

Note that the BTS app does not need to be running to use this app (in fact it is best if it isn't to avoid conflicting messaging).
